input.free_text_description: This system is a IoT platform that serves Content Creator, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for sub listener, default auto, channel. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Content Creator, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a Content Creator, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As a Content Creator, I want to use default auto capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Content Creator, I want to use channel capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
